title: Mouse with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='40' ry='34' fill='#1b2a4a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M22 72 Q6 76 8 62 Q10 50 20 55' stroke='#ff9ec4' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#9fb8e8'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#f7d9e8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='36' r='13' fill='#7d9bd8'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='36' r='13' fill='#7d9bd8'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='36' r='7.5' fill='#ffb3d1'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='36' r='7.5' fill='#ffb3d1'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='26' fill='#aec6f0'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#fbe3ef'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='3.6' fill='#ff7fb0'/>

  <path d='M50 58 Q50 64 44 63' stroke='#e0669c' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 58 Q50 64 56 63' stroke='#e0669c' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M34 56 L18 52' stroke='#cfe0ff' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M34 60 L17 62' stroke='#cfe0ff' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 56 L82 52' stroke='#cfe0ff' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 60 L83 62' stroke='#cfe0ff' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='45' rx='6.5' ry='7.5' fill='#2d2a6e'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='45' rx='6.5' ry='7.5' fill='#2d2a6e'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='42' r='2.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='62.5' cy='42' r='2.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='48' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='48' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- sparkles around eyes -->
  <path d='M31 33 l1.6 3.4 3.4 1.6 -3.4 1.6 -1.6 3.4 -1.6 -3.4 -3.4 -1.6 3.4 -1.6z' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <path d='M69 33 l1.6 3.4 3.4 1.6 -3.4 1.6 -1.6 3.4 -1.6 -3.4 -3.4 -1.6 3.4 -1.6z' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <path d='M50 30 l1.2 2.6 2.6 1.2 -2.6 1.2 -1.2 2.6 -1.2 -2.6 -2.6 -1.2 2.6 -1.2z' fill='#fff2b0'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='84' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#ffb3d1'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='84' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#ffb3d1'/>
